## Downloadable models

Models are not part of the app: they are downloaded on demand from the source below and checked against a pinned SHA-256.

| Silero VAD v6.2 (GGUF) | voice activity detection | [MIT](https://github.com/snakers4/silero-vad/blob/master/LICENSE) | <https://huggingface.co/handy-computer/silero-vad-v6.2-gguf/resolve/main/silero-vad-v6.2-F32.gguf> |
